doc.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023

title: Origins of the Second Trumpet Concerto and the Ruben Simeo performances
summary: Sandoval says he never recorded the second concerto; Ruben Simeo has played it, and a planned Los Angeles recording was derailed by the pandemic.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Which brings me to last night I was listening to your Second Trumpet Concerto and I know that this is maybe not a major part of what you do but I really enjoyed the piece.
And I had a couple of questions about it. First of all when you decided to write another trumpet concerto, did you decide partly because the first one was successful?
I have a question. Where you listened to that? Because I never recorded the second one.
I believe it’s a YouTube with a young man, you weren’t playing it, a young man playing it.

Oh Ruben Simeo oh yeah he played it several times. Yes. But you know unfortunately we had everything ready to do a recording here in L.A. and then the beginning of the pandemic started and everything got screwed up.
Well did you decide that it was going to be three movements when you started it or is that something that happens along the way?
